profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a full stack Web developer with a proven ability to learn quickly. Demonstrating my dedication and capability, I successfully completed an intensive bootcamp at V School in record time, showcasing my commitment to learning and skill acquisition. My education at V School equipped me with a comprehensive understanding of web development, covering front-end and back-end technologies. I am adept in utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.JS, Node.JS, MongoDB, and RESTful methods to create dynamic and responsive web applications. Now, I am seeking a challenging position as a full stack Web developer where I can contribute my skills to a collaborative team and continue to expand my knowledge in the ever-evolving field of web development. I am enthusiastic about leveraging my expertise to drive impactful solutions and contribute to the success of innovative projects.

positions.title: Web Development Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
In my role as a teaching assistant at V School, my job is to ensure an enriching learning experience for the enrolled students. I assist students in their assignments and coding challenges, guiding them through complex problems while encouraging them to find their own solutions, fostering their growth and independence, swiftly responding to student inquiries, providing timely and helpful support, ensuring their learning journey remains uninterrupted. Moreover, I maintain open lines of communication with fellow teaching assistants and instructors, collaborating effectively to address challenges and improve the overall student experience.
- Provided prompt and thorough responses to student inquiries, effectively managing and responding to queries with strong communication skills, ensuring timely and helpful assistance, which led to improved student satisfaction and quicker issue resolution.
- Applied effective problem-solving skills to address complex challenges in student learning, enhancing student understanding and contributing to a more effective learning environment.
- Escalated unresolved inquiries to other teaching assistants and instructors, collaborating with the team to foster a group-based approach to problem resolution, enhancing the overall quality of student support.
- Facilitated communication by forwarding students' requests for clarifications to the relevant instructors, streamlining the learning process and contributing to a more efficient and responsive educational environment.

positions.description: I took a few years pause from my career in order to raise my twins and dedicate myself to being a full time homemaker. positions.title: Physical Therapist
positions.description:
As a physical therapist, my role was to be a part of a patient-centered team. I used my communication and analytical skills as well as standardized tests in order to accurately diagnose my patients, create a customized plan of care, relate my findings and plan to the referring physician, including my recommendations for further medical interventions, as well as supervising and coaching physical therapy assistants in their duties.
- Maximized productivity and resource allocation in healthcare service delivery by managing time and clinic resources judiciously, reflecting a commitment to quality care and efficient resource use, leading to improved clinic operations and patient service.
- Collaborated seamlessly with an interdisciplinary team, utilizing effective communication and coordination skills to provide comprehensive care, addressing the diverse needs of patients, resulting in enhanced patient satisfaction and care outcomes.
- Demonstrated meticulous documentation skills by capturing interventions clearly and concisely, maintaining accurate records, and facilitating seamless communication among healthcare professionals, thereby ensuring consistency and quality in patient care.
- Took responsibility for ongoing professional development in the field of physical therapy, engaging in continuous education to stay updated with the latest advancements and best practices, contributing to enhanced treatment efficacy and knowledge in the team.

projects.title: Run Tracker
projects.description:
An application to log runs as well as interact with fellow runners. In building this web-based application, I built
upon my knowledge of the MERN stack in addition to adding authentication to the application, allowing for multiple
individual users.
● Implemented robust authentication and security measures by integrating JWT, express-JWT, and the Bcrypt
library, addressing security concerns effectively and enhancing the overall security posture of the application,
resulting in a more secure and reliable user experience.
● Adhered to a mobile-first design approach, ensuring optimal user experience on various display sizes while
maintaining responsiveness, applying advanced design principles to create an accessible and user-friendly
interface, leading to increased user engagement and satisfaction across multiple devices.
● Iteratively enhanced the application based on user feedback, demonstrating a commitment to continuous
improvement and user satisfaction, using feedback-driven development strategies to refine features and
functionality, which resulted in a more user-centric and efficient application.

projects.title: Morning Routines App
projects.description:
An application to help improve mindfulness and readiness for the upcoming day. In building this web-based
application, I displayed a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript es6, React.JS, Node.JS, MongoDB, and
RESTful methods to develop frontend design.
● Constructed multiple APIs following RESTful standards, utilizing my expertise in API development to create
efficient and scalable web services, which resulted in robust and seamless backend functionality for various
applications.
● Created a responsive and dynamic front-end design using React, CSS styling, and JavaScript, applying
advanced front-end development skills to enhance user experience and interactivity, leading to higher user
engagement and satisfaction.
● Developed and implemented reusable React components for the Morning Routine App, streamlining code
structure and enhancing maintainability, which promoted an efficient and scalable approach in the application's
development, contributing to its overall performance and ease of future updates.
